securityMappings.relationshipDefaults: Only null or a live same-package RelationshipView. Scalar false/zero are rejected as invalid typed defaults, never silently treated as null.
securityMappings.removedRelationships: pop/popitem retain the removed handle identity, whose subsequent reads fail with StaleHandleError; batch serializes an opaque typed handle, never leaked target metadata.
securityMappings.imageAppend: Package parts are a unique URI-keyed graph. Appending an already admitted owned image is idempotent; foreign images require explicit admission/import.
securityMappings.factories: Original deterministic template and injected VFS bytes replace unrestricted host paths; no ambient I/O/time/network.

languageMappings.numeric: Zero-based readonly numeric access and signed at; unsafe or fractional indexes reject. Established signed numeric bracket compatibility remains.
languageMappings.slices: Half-open clamped start/end for _Rows, Sections and RGBColor only. _Columns, InlineShapes, TabStops, Comments and ImageParts do not gain slice.
languageMappings.keyed: Comments.get uses nonnegative storage IDs and returns null when missing. Relationships retain string rIds, keyed at/get, keys/values/items and insertion order. Sparse IDs never become ordinals. Styles retain their earlier explicit ID-fallback drift mapping.
languageMappings.sequenceSearch: Sections count/index/includes/reversed cover inherited sequence protocols; owner/node equality replaces allocated wrapper identity. RGB tuple values map through toArray and explicit JS array operations.
languageMappings.values: All seven unit helpers, six unit accessors, 19 canonical enum families, 262 named values/261 canonical values and eleven family aliases retain earlier passing acceptance. No DOCX centipoint helper or undocumented aliases are invented.

unitCoverageBasis: The pinned DescribeSections units cover length/iteration/integer/slice only; DescribeRelationships covers defined relationship operations, with no inherited dictionary protocol unit cases. The original tests independently qualify these public obligations. No whole source-test adaptation is claimed.
